passages.text: Plants of the World Online account: Lonicera hildebrandtiana Collett & Hemsl..
The native range of this species is Arunachal Pradesh to China (Yunnan, Guangxi) and N. Indo-China. It is a climber and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.
